fact_text: Titan One is a project in Kolachi Housing Society, a private society in central Karachi, and was described in February 2026 as being in its completion stage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Kolachi Housing Society sits between Gulshan-e-Iqbal and Gulistan-e-Jauhar, with Shahrah-e-Faisal said to be 5 to 7 minutes away and Bhadurabad and Shafabad 7 to 8 minutes away.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Titan One has four towers, and the developer said every flat in them is a corner flat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The developer said the wide gaps between the four towers let wind flow through, and its Dubai-based architects and engineers were asked for airy flats with west-facing openings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Each tower floor has two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, served by two lifts and a central staircase that connects the whole tower.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The first floors of the two front towers, A and B, are reserved for amenities: separate men's and women's pools, separate gyms, a prayer area and a community hall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The swimming pools are moderate-sized rather than commercial-sized, according to the former ABAD vice chairman interviewed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Security is a single access point with a guard, and the separate towers mean children must go down and back up to move between the amenity floors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The three-level penthouse includes a 250 sq yd bungalow across its ground and first floors, with a roof barbecue area, a washing area and a small private pool for children.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Two-bedroom units convert to four-bedroom duplexes and three-bedroom units to five-bedroom three-level penthouses, with one room on the ground level and the rest above.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: A two-bedroom unit is quoted at about 1,890 sq ft gross and about 1,200 to 1,300 sq ft net.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The five-bedroom three-level penthouse is about 6,000 sq ft gross and about 5,200 sq ft net, and the developer said its circulation space grows with each level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Corner, west-open and society-facing units carry extra premiums on top of the base price, the developer said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The developer argued that gated community living is becoming more common in Pakistan because of security concerns, and that buyers pay a premium for peace of mind.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The developer said extended-family living is declining because of limited space, so its design gives parents a ground-floor unit and the younger family the upper levels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) requires each new project to display a board with its SBCA and ABAD licence numbers and a barcode that buyers can scan to check authenticity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Before buying a flat, villa or plot, check the project's licensing: ABAD membership, SBCA approval, and the licence numbers and barcode on the project board.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: Buyers can search a project by name on the SBCA website to see its details, and the authority has been moving its records online.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: ABAD will confirm by email whether a builder is a current member, and a builder whose membership has lapsed is treated as a suspended member, the speaker said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)

fact_text: The former ABAD vice chairman said property is less volatile than gold or stocks, and an owner keeps the title document and rent while the property can be leased or pledged to a bank for a loan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What to Consider Before Investing in Titan One | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-02-22)
